normal_signature: Single, isolated, contiguous white region against a pure black background
Granular, stippled texture filling the interior of the shape
Organic, irregular, and smooth boundary contours
Absence of internal voids or holes within the white mass
No external artifacts, noise, or secondary objects in the frame
Do not flag images as anomalous if the entire object exhibits a uniform, high-frequency speckled texture, even if it appears noisy or grainy.
Do not flag an object as anomalous solely based on extreme size reduction if the object retains the correct class-specific texture and shape.
Do not flag small, isolated, textured objects as anomalies if they lack complex internal voids or irregular morphology.
Classify isolated, textured, elongated objects on a uniform dark background as normal if no distinct structural defects are present.
Do not classify small, isolated dark voids within the central region of the object as anomalies if the surrounding texture remains consistent.
hypothesized_anomaly_modes: Structural fragmentation: The object breaks into multiple disconnected components or islands.
Internal cavitation: The presence of black holes or voids within the white region, indicating missing material.
Surface erosion: The texture becomes sparse, patchy, or non-uniform, deviating from the dense stippled pattern.
Geometric deformation: The object exhibits unnatural sharp angles, straight lines, or extreme elongation inconsistent with the organic class shape.
Contamination: Appearance of foreign objects or noise clusters in the black background area.
Classify objects as anomalies if they appear fragmented, lack coherent structure, or exhibit irregular, non-organic shapes compared to reference samples.
If a single object exhibits high internal fragmentation or speckled texture, classify as anomaly regardless of reference tolerance for component separation.
Flag objects with high-frequency granular or speckled texture patterns as anomalies, even if their global shape and size match the normal profile.
Flag as anomaly if a distinct, high-contrast dark spot or void is embedded within the textured object body.
Flag as anomaly if a distinct, high-contrast dark spot is embedded within the object's textured body, regardless of shape variations.
